white.$description: Pure white. Cards, panels, sheets and popovers (via surface-card); text and icons on dark and semantic fills.

50.$description: Ink ramp (tints of navy). The light steps 50–400 are disabled / low-emphasis ink: reach for paper-* (fills) or rule-* (lines) first. The Pharos-faithful components still use 50/100/200 for hover and press bands (un-migrated).

100.$description: Ink ramp (tints of navy). The light steps 50–400 are disabled / low-emphasis ink: reach for paper-* (fills) or rule-* (lines) first. The Pharos-faithful components still use 50/100/200 for hover and press bands (un-migrated).

200.$description: Ink ramp (tints of navy). The light steps 50–400 are disabled / low-emphasis ink: reach for paper-* (fills) or rule-* (lines) first. The Pharos-faithful components still use 50/100/200 for hover and press bands (un-migrated).

300.$description: Ink ramp (tints of navy). The light steps 50–400 are disabled / low-emphasis ink: reach for paper-* (fills) or rule-* (lines) first. The Pharos-faithful components still use 50/100/200 for hover and press bands (un-migrated).

400.$description: Ink ramp (tints of navy). The light steps 50–400 are disabled / low-emphasis ink: reach for paper-* (fills) or rule-* (lines) first. The Pharos-faithful components still use 50/100/200 for hover and press bands (un-migrated).

500.$description: Ink: de-emphasised text on the warm ground and on white; the 1px border of interactive controls (Input, secondary Button, outline Badge, Select, Combobox), clearing WCAG 3:1 non-text contrast.

600.$description: Ink: secondary body text on paper-* and white.

700.$description: Ink: labels and captions on paper-* and white; hover of the primary Button.

800.$description: Ink ramp step between 700 and 900 (fixed: no longer lighter than 700).

900.$description: Brand navy #101820. Primary text, icons and headlines on paper-* and white; the primary Button fill.

950.$description: Deepest ink; press state of the primary Button.

50.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

100.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

200.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

300.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

400.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

500.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

600.$description: Seablue, the brand hue (≈ #2A48E9). The one blue anchor per view: action, focus ring (2px white halo + 4px primary-600), selection, links, AI/copilot.

700.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

800.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

900.$description: Seablue ramp: signature and signal — action, focus, selection, links, AI/copilot. Never structural chrome.

fg.$description: System state only: success fill and success text colour; pair with semantic-success-on on the fill (WCAG AA). #027E3F — chroma clamped to the sRGB gamut edge.

bg.$description: System state only: tinted success background (fg at 6.3%).

on.$description: Text and icons on a semantic-success-fg fill.

fg.$description: System state only: error fill and error text colour; pair with semantic-error-on on the fill (WCAG AA). Single red (laser-red merged); also the destructive Button fill and its focus ring.

fg-hover.$description: Hover of an error / destructive fill. #AD020E.

fg-active.$description: Press of an error / destructive fill. #8A0209.

bg.$description: System state only: tinted error background (fg at 6.3%).

on.$description: Text and icons on a semantic-error-fg fill.

fg.$description: System state only: warning fill and warning text colour; pair with semantic-warning-on on the fill (WCAG AA).

bg.$description: System state only: tinted warning background (fg at 6.3%).

on.$description: Dark text on a semantic-warning-fg (amber) fill.

fg.$description: System state only: info fill and info text colour; pair with semantic-info-on on the fill (WCAG AA). #026DB0 — chroma clamped to the sRGB gamut edge.

bg.$description: System state only: tinted info background (fg at 6.3%).

on.$description: Text and icons on a semantic-info-fg fill.

50.$description: Warm paper #FEFDFB — all but white, a spark of warmth. Fill: hover rows, zebra banding, the faintest lift off white (surface-sunken). Never a border.

100.$description: Warm paper #FEF9F4 — the app canvas, the page itself (surface-canvas). Never a border.

200.$description: Warm paper #F8F2EC — light fills on the canvas: chips, tracks, step circles, inputs. Never a border.

300.$description: Warm paper #EEE8E2 — stronger fill: disabled surfaces, switch off-track. Never a border.

subtle.$description: Line #DFE3E8 (ink family): default divider, card border — on white and on the warm ground.

strong.$description: Line #C9D0D7 (ink family): emphatic rule, dashed placeholder.

canvas.$description: Page / app background (→ paper-100). Prefer the semantic aliases in new work.

50.$description: Tint surfaces and soft badges (#FEF0EB); bg of a warm tint block (text 900) or a tag (text 700).

100.$description: Terracotta tint #FDE1D6: tag and chip fills when many show at once.

200.$description: Subtle terracotta borders and rules; low end of chart ramps (#F9C8B5).

600.$description: BASE — the brand terracotta #C4633A. Solid fills with no small text (bars, blocks, ≥18.66px bold / ≥24px), emphatic rules. 4.04:1 on white either way: large text only. Never a control, focus ring, link or state.

700.$description: Terracotta ink #A24A28: accent text on white (5.92:1, AA); solid marks carrying small white text; hover of a 600 fill.

800.$description: Press step of a terracotta fill (#79371A).

900.$description: Deep text on a terracotta tint (#552612).

fg.$description: Accessible ink for warm-accent blocks on white (→ terracotta-700).

bg.$description: Tint surface for warm-accent blocks on white (→ terracotta-50).

on.$description: Text on a solid terracotta mark (use on 700 for small text).
